exposure: Calf pulmonary surfactant + budesonide for injection (PS + BUD)
cohort: Premature fetal rabbits delivered by cesarean section on the 28th day of pregnancy.
finding: Intratracheal instillation of budesonide during early postnatal life is effective in promoting alveolarization and increasing SP-B expression in premature fetal rabbits, with the combination of budesonide and pulmonary surfactant being superior to either alone.
